characters.summary: Mewtwo is a Psychic-type Pokémon created through gene splicing and DNA engineering, described by the Pokédex as having the most savage heart among Pokémon. It has very high Special Attack and Speed, the signature move Psystrike, and a broad movepool including Psychic, Aura Sphere, Shadow Ball, Barrier and Recover, plus elemental TMs (Thunderbolt, Ice Beam, Fire Blast) and Teleport.

techniques: Thunderbolt, Ice Beam and Fire Blast (TMs)

weaknesses: Bug, Ghost and Dark attacks are super effective
limitations: Cannot learn Fly or Surf (Gen 1 learnset)

sources.supports: Mewtwo: Psychic type, Pressure/Unnerve, base stats total 680 (Sp. Atk 154, Speed 130), 2.0 m; weak to Bug, Ghost and Dark; Pokédex: created by gene splicing and DNA engineering, most savage heart among Pokémon. Mega Mewtwo X: Psychic/Fighting, Steadfast, Attack 190, 2.3 m, weak to Flying, Ghost and Fairy, muscles enhanced by psychic power. Mega Mewtwo Y: Psychic, Insomnia, Sp. Atk 194, Speed 140, 1.5 m, weak to Bug, Ghost and Dark; mental power can smash a skyscraper with a mere thought (Let's Go entry).

Gen 1 (Red/Blue/Yellow) learnset: Confusion, Disable, Psychic, Swift, Barrier, Recover, Mist, Amnesia by level; TMs include Ice Beam (13), Blizzard (14), Submission (17), Thunderbolt (24), Thunder (25), Psychic (29), Teleport (30), Fire Blast (38); no Fly or Surf.
Gen 6 learnset: Psystrike (Lv 100), Psycho Cut, Psychic, Aura Sphere, Recover, Barrier; TMs include Shadow Ball, Thunderbolt, Ice Beam, Flamethrower, Fire Blast.

campaignTags.claim: Psychic-type Pokémon whose attacks include Psystrike and Psychic.
Learns Thunderbolt (TM24) and Thunder (TM25) in Gen 1 (owner ruling: learnable moves count).
Learns Ice Beam (TM13) and Blizzard (TM14) in Gen 1 (owner ruling: learnable moves count).
Learns Fire Blast (TM38) in Gen 1 (owner ruling: learnable moves count).

characters.summary: Ms. Pac-Man scores by eating pellets in mazes while four ghosts (Blinky, Pinky, Inky and Sue) pursue her. Eating a power pellet turns the ghosts blue so she can eat them; ghost contact otherwise costs a life, and the power pellet effect shrinks and eventually stops in later rounds.

techniques: Eating vulnerable (blue) ghosts after a power pellet

mechanisms: Not established by the cited source

weaknesses: Contact with a non-vulnerable ghost costs a life
limitations: Power pellet vulnerability shortens as rounds progress and eventually stops altogether

sources.supports: Player earns points by eating pellets and avoiding ghosts Blinky, Pinky, Inky and Sue; energizers turn ghosts blue so she can eat them; energizer duration lessens with rounds and eventually stops; ghost contact loses a life; mazes have one or two sets of warp tunnels.

characters.summary: Nathan Drake is a treasure hunter whose main proficiency is guns (handguns, rifles, shotguns, crossbows). He is a capable unarmed fighter, close to a one-man army, uses stealth takedowns and explosives, and is a skilled free-runner and climber. He defeated Navarro, Lazarević, Talbot and Rafe, but can be overwhelmed: Nadine beat him quickly in their first fight.

mechanisms: Endurance: kept going after being shot (Uncharted 2)

weaknesses: Can be overwhelmed or overpowered; his self-taught style failed against Nadine
Gunshot wounds wear him down over time

sources.supports: Main proficiency is guns (handguns, semi-automatic rifles, shotguns, crossbows); very capable unarmed, close to a one-man army; stealth takedowns and chokeholds; good with grenades and explosives; skilled free runner and climber; defeated Navarro, Lazarević (explosive resin), Rafe (treasure pile) and Talbot (pistol after knife fight); shot by Flynn in Uncharted 2 and kept going; survived a fall from a plane; not invincible, beaten quickly by Nadine; pinned down by Marlowe's agents.

feats.claim: Survived a fall from a plane by catching a cargo container mid-air and deploying its parachute.
Kept climbing a derailed train after being shot by Harry Flynn.

characters.summary: Ness is the protagonist of EarthBound, a boy with PSI who fights mostly with baseball bats. His signature offensive PSI, PSI Rockin, hits all enemies; he is a strong healer (Lifeup, Healing) and learns Teleport. He defeated Pokey, Master Belch and Starman DX, and finally vanquished Giygas with help from his friends' prayers.

techniques: PSI Rockin (hits all enemies; α to Ω)

weaknesses: Low Speed: often acts last and misses fast enemies such as UFOs
mobility: PSI Teleport α/β to previously visited places
limitations: PSI costs PP (PSI Rockin α 10 PP up to Ω 98 PP)
Teleport needs a run-up and fails if he hits something before top speed

sources.supports: Ness uses mostly baseball bats; strong healer with Lifeup and Healing; high HP, PP, Offense, Vitality and Guts (SMAAAASH!! chance); low Speed means he often acts last and misses fast enemies; defeated Starman Jr., Pokey, Master Belch, Starman DX and others; Giygas vanquished with help from friends' prayers.
PSI Rockin is Ness's signature offensive PSI, only in EarthBound; levels α (8), β (22), γ (49), Ω (75); hits all enemies (Ω 320-960 damage); PP cost 10 to 98; only Ness learns it.

Ness learns Teleport α (from a monkey in Dusty Dunes Desert) and β (after his nightmare in Magicant); the user runs until top speed then reappears at a previously visited place; colliding first makes it fail and still costs PP.

campaignTags.claim: Uses PSI, including his signature PSI Rockin.
Strong healer with Lifeup and Healing PSI.
Learns PSI Teleport α and β.

unknowns: The earlier PSI Fire claim was wrong for Ness (not on his opened pages); fire tag not added.
Homesickness status and PSI Shield were not covered by the opened pages.

notableResults.note: Vanquished with help from his friends' prayers (Paula prays for strength).
Listed among the enemies Ness defeats.
